_comment: velocity m/s, gravity = projectile gravity scale. Optional: acceleration (m/s^2, negative = slows down) + acceleration_time (s), arc low/high, aim overlay/elevation, unit deg/mil, angle_offset, min_distance, elevation_limits [min,max], bore (deg: how far above the screen centre the shot leaves; the game fires along the barrel socket Attach_Muzzle, tilted against the camera), zoom (the optic's FOV divisor on RMB) + zoom_bore (bore in that view), category, note. Sources: velocity, gravity and rocket boost read from the game files (Squad build 26005357: WeaponConfig.MuzzleVelocity, projectile ProjectileGravityScale, ConstantAcceleration/Timeout capped at MaxSpeed); elevation limits, arcs and the AGS-17 hold model from in-game measurements, the official Squad wiki (squad.fandom.com) and SquadCalc (github.com/sh4rkman/SquadCalc).

M203 / M320 / GP-25 / HK79 / SL40.note: Under-barrel grenade: arms after ~10 m, a slow and high arc — always enter the height difference.

MGL / M32.note: Under-barrel grenade: arms after ~10 m, a slow and high arc — always enter the height difference.

AK-40GL (MPT-76).note: Under-barrel grenade: arms after ~10 m, a slow and high arc — always enter the height difference.

QLG10.note: Under-barrel grenade: arms after ~10 m, a slow and high arc — always enter the height difference.

Rifle grenade.note: Under-barrel grenade: arms after ~10 m, a slow and high arc — always enter the height difference.

MK19.note: Fire short bursts and walk the impacts onto the target; minimum arming range ~30 m. The tripod MK19 (and C16 / L134A1) fires faster: pick "MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1"; for the AGS-17 pick "AGS-17 · emplacement".

MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1.note: Tripod MK19, C16 and L134A1: 235 m/s against 230 m/s on vehicles. Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.

AGS-17 · emplacement.note: High arc: W puts the barrel up, hold S for the shown time (the app beeps). Low arc: aim with the overlay mark. Velocity 185 m/s and gravity ×1.8 come from the game files; the hold rate and the top of the mount are fitted on 67 in-game hold-time measurements (280–1930 m, 7 m RMS error), the same as the Deadline SquadCalc.

QLZ87.note: Tripod QLZ87. Its optic (RMB, ×3) is zeroed at 100 m; without it the shot leaves 0.9° below the screen centre — the mark accounts for both, pick the view you aim from. Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.

QLZ87 · Lynx / CSK131.note: QLZ87 on the Lynx and CSK131: the shot leaves 0.85° above the screen centre (zero ~110 m), with or without the optic (RMB, ×3). Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.

AGS-30 / BTR-4 AGS.note: Fire short bursts and walk the impacts onto the target; minimum arming range ~30 m.

RPG-7 · PG-7V HEAT / OG-7V.note: The rocket motor speeds the projectile up after launch; the booster is included in the calculation.

RPG-7 · PG-7VR Tandem.note: The rocket motor speeds the projectile up after launch; the booster is included in the calculation.

RPG-7 · TBG-7V Thermobaric.note: The rocket motor speeds the projectile up after launch; the booster is included in the calculation.

RPG-7V1 · HEAT.note: The rocket motor speeds the projectile up after launch; the booster is included in the calculation.

M3 MAAWS · HEAT / Smoke.note: The rocket motor speeds the projectile up after launch; the booster is included in the calculation.

M3 MAAWS · Tandem.note: The rocket motor speeds the projectile up after launch; the booster is included in the calculation.

Carl Gustav M2 · FFV551 HEAT.note: Leaves the barrel at full speed: no booster phase in the calculation.

Carl Gustav M2 · FFV441D HE.note: Leaves the barrel at full speed: no booster phase in the calculation.

Carl Gustav M2 · FFV751 Tandem.note: Leaves the barrel at full speed: no booster phase in the calculation.

NLAW.note: Gravity is disabled for the NLAW in game: no drop, aim straight at the target.

SPG-9 · HEAT.note: HEAT and FRAG shells fly at different speeds — pick the shell you have loaded.

SPG-9 · FRAG.note: HEAT and FRAG shells fly at different speeds — pick the shell you have loaded.

2A28 Grom (BMP-1 / BMD-1) · HEAT.note: HEAT and FRAG shells fly at different speeds — pick the shell you have loaded.

2A28 Grom (BMP-1 / BMD-1) · FRAG.note: HEAT and FRAG shells fly at different speeds — pick the shell you have loaded.

Tank AP · 2A46 / ZPT98 / 2A20 / 2A45 / K.note: Fast shell, small drop: the correction matters mostly beyond ~800 m.

Tank AP · M256 / Rh120.note: Fast shell, small drop: the correction matters mostly beyond ~800 m.

Tank AP · L30A1 (Challenger 2) / M68A2.note: Fast shell, small drop: the correction matters mostly beyond ~800 m.

Tank HEAT/HE · M256 / Rh120 / 2A46 / ZPT.note: Fast shell, small drop: the correction matters mostly beyond ~800 m.

Tank HESH · L30A1 (Challenger 2).note: Slow shell (670 m/s, the L30A1 smoke too): it drops noticeably, enter the distance precisely.

ZPL-98A 105mm (ZTD-05) · AP.note: Fast shell, small drop: the correction matters mostly beyond ~800 m.

ZPL-98A 105mm (ZTD-05) · HEAT / HE.note: Fast shell, small drop: the correction matters mostly beyond ~800 m.

Mortar (M252 / 2B14 / L16 / Type 63).note: Set the mils on the mortar sight. Range 51–1237 m. Auto-lay: W raises the barrel to its top (1580 mil), S lowers it at 9°/s (game files: keyboard pitch ×300 × input ×0.03, the same rule gives the AGS-17's measured 9.08°/s).

Technical Mortar.note: Angle is the value on the technical's elevation readout.

Hell Cannon.note: Set degrees on the elevation scale; the shell is slow — expect a long flight.

UB-32 (S-5 rockets).note: Rockets slow down during the first 2 s; fire in salvos and correct by the impacts.

Technical UB-32.note: Rockets slow down during the first 2 s; fire in salvos and correct by the impacts.
